note: Responsive Image Link Formatter is a submodule of Image Link Formatter. It provides one image field formatter, id 'responsive_image_link_formatter' (label 'Responsive image wrapped within link field'), that extends core ResponsiveImageFormatter and mixes in the parent's ImageLinkFormatterTrait: it keeps responsive-image settings (responsive_image_style) plus the core image_link 'Link image to' option, adds the entity's Link fields to that dropdown, and wraps each responsive image in the same-delta Link field URL. Configured on core.entity_view_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode>: content.<image_field>.type = responsive_image_link_formatter and settings.image_link = <link field machine name>. Requires image_link_formatter + responsive_image and a configured responsive image style (this site has 'wide' and 'narrow'). No configure route, no permission, no Drush, no config schema. Medium cases read a live view display; hard cases set the formatter/link, verified against entity_view_display config. Fixtures use namespaced field_rilf_img (image) + field_rilf_link (link) on Article and delete them (scoped) in cleanup/reset.

evals.prompt: I need responsive images (picture/srcset) that are also clickable, linking to a URL from a Link field. Which module/submodule and which formatter do I use, and what is it called in Manage display?
must_contain_any: Responsive image wrapped within link field
evals.expected_output: Use the Responsive Image Link Formatter submodule and set the image field's formatter to 'Responsive image wrapped within link field' (plugin id responsive_image_link_formatter). Choose a responsive image style and, in 'Link image to', select the Link field to wrap the image with.

evals.prompt: What does the Responsive Image Link Formatter require to work, and which settings does its formatter expose?
evals.expected_output: It requires the parent image_link_formatter module and core responsive_image, plus a configured responsive image style to select. Its formatter exposes the core responsive-image settings (responsive_image_style) and the image_link 'Link image to' setting, which is extended to accept a Link field machine name.

evals.prompt: How does responsive_image_link_formatter differ from the parent image_link_formatter internally, and does it wrap images the same way?
evals.expected_output: The parent extends core ImageFormatter; this submodule extends core ResponsiveImageFormatter. Both mix in the same ImageLinkFormatterTrait, so the link behaviour is identical - each image is wrapped in the same-delta Link field URL - only the base output differs (responsive picture/srcset vs a single image style).

evals.prompt: On this site, the Article content type has an image field 'field_rilf_img'. Inspect the live default view display for Article and state which field formatter is applied to that image field.
evals.expected_output: The formatter is responsive_image_link_formatter ('Responsive image wrapped within link field'): in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_rilf_img component has type responsive_image_link_formatter.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article image field 'field_rilf_img' is displayed with the Responsive Image Link Formatter. Inspect the live view display and tell me which Link field's URL wraps the responsive image.
evals.expected_output: The link field is field_rilf_link: in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_rilf_img component's settings.image_link = field_rilf_link.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has an image field 'field_rilf_img' and a link field 'field_rilf_link'. On the default view display the image currently uses the core responsive image formatter. Using the Responsive Image Link Formatter, change the image field so the responsive image is rendered wrapped in the link from field_rilf_link (keep it responsive). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default set field_rilf_img component type to responsive_image_link_formatter (keeping a responsive_image_style) with settings.image_link = field_rilf_link, then save. Verify checks type === responsive_image_link_formatter and settings.image_link === field_rilf_link.

evals.prompt: On the Article display for this site, the responsive images in 'field_rilf_img' are shown with the Responsive Image Link Formatter but they aren't clickable. There is a link field 'field_rilf_link' on the same content. Make the responsive images link to the URL from that link field. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set the field_rilf_img component's settings.image_link to field_rilf_link (keeping type responsive_image_link_formatter) on core.entity_view_display.node.article.default and save. Verify checks type === responsive_image_link_formatter and settings.image_link === field_rilf_link.
